description: This PHP source file defines the ElastiCacheClient class within the Aws\ElastiCache namespace. The class extends AwsClient and provides methods to interact with the Amazon ElastiCache service, including both synchronous and asynchronous operations. The file includes method docblocks for various API actions related to ElastiCache, such as creating, deleting, and describing cache clusters and related resources.

classes.name: ElastiCacheClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with the Amazon ElastiCache service. Extends the AwsClient class and provides methods for various ElastiCache operations, both synchronous and asynchronous, as indicated by the method annotations.

methods.name: addTagsToResource
methods.description: Adds tags to a specified ElastiCache resource.

methods.name: authorizeCacheSecurityGroupIngress
methods.description: Allows network ingress to a cache security group.

methods.name: batchApplyUpdateAction
methods.description: Applies a batch of cache parameter group or replication group update actions.

methods.name: batchStopUpdateAction
methods.description: Stops a batch of cache parameter group or replication group update actions.

methods.name: completeMigration
methods.description: Completes the migration of a cache cluster.

methods.name: createCacheParameterGroup
methods.description: Creates a new cache parameter group.

methods.name: createCacheSecurityGroup
methods.description: Creates a new cache security group.

methods.name: createCacheSubnetGroup
methods.description: Creates a new cache subnet group.

methods.name: createServerlessCacheSnapshot
methods.description: Creates a snapshot of a serverless cache.

methods.name: createSnapshot
methods.description: Creates a snapshot of a cache cluster.

methods.name: decreaseNodeGroupsInGlobalReplicationGroup
methods.description: Decreases the number of node groups in a global replication group.

methods.name: decreaseReplicaCount
methods.description: Decreases the number of replica nodes.

methods.name: describeCacheClusters
methods.description: Describes one or more cache clusters.

methods.name: describeCacheEngineVersions
methods.description: Describes the available cache engine versions.

methods.name: describeCacheParameters
methods.description: Describes parameters of a cache parameter group.

methods.name: describeEngineDefaultParameters
methods.description: Describes the default parameters for the engine.

methods.name: describeReplicationGroups
methods.description: Describes one or more replication groups.

methods.name: failoverGlobalReplicationGroup
methods.description: Performs a failover of a global replication group.

methods.name: increaseNodeGroupsInGlobalReplicationGroup
methods.description: Increases the number of node groups in a global replication group.

methods.name: increaseReplicaCount
methods.description: Increases the number of replica nodes.

methods.name: listAllowedNodeTypeModifications
methods.description: Lists allowed modifications for node types.

methods.name: modifyReplicationGroupShardConfiguration
methods.description: Modifies the shard configuration of a replication group.

methods.name: purchaseReservedCacheNodesOffering
methods.description: Purchases a reserved cache nodes offering.

methods.name: rebalanceSlotsInGlobalReplicationGroup
methods.description: Rebalances slots in a global replication group.

methods.name: revokeCacheSecurityGroupIngress
methods.description: Revokes ingress from a cache security group.

methods.name: testFailover
methods.description: Tests a failover of a cache cluster.
